site.method: EIA-860M plant coordinates (Lydian Energy / plant 67222 'Yellow Vikings' -- name is a near-exact match to the queue project, not a coincidental county+MW fallback bind); corroborated by IA Exhibit C text (Nautilus Switch on FM 2174, Hood County side of the interconnect) and by OSM/Overpass: FM 2174 and a 345kV line both found within 5 km of the coordinate, and the point itself falls in Somervell County -- matching the ERCOT queue's own county field (queue says Somervell; GEM wiki's 'Hood County' claim is likely referring to the switchyard side of the county line, a documented tri-county convergence in this area)

construction.note: AWS Open Data Sentinel-2 chips (s2aws.py) obtained this run at the verified site coordinate, replacing the prior triage-stage imagery which was centered on a since-rejected POI guess (Comanche Peak Nuclear Plant, ~12-19 km off) and never refreshed after the deep scan found the correct EIA coordinate (CDSE 402'd at the time). All 4 years (2022/2024/2025/2026) plus a wider 7km check show only pre-existing sand/limestone quarry operations near the interconnect point -- no solar array, staging, or grading visible. Consistent with EIA status '(L) Regulatory approvals pending. Not under construction' as of 2026-05, and with the NTP construction deadline (2025-07-01) having passed with no queue construction-start milestone.

cod_assessment.rationale: Contractual COD 2027-07-13 confirmed in IA Amend 1+2+3; EIA reports '(L) not under construction' as of 2026-05. NTP construction deadline 2025-07-01 is 12 months past. In-Service deadline 2027-05-13 gives only 10 months from today. No construction milestone in ERCOT queue. Hood County abatement terminated Feb 2025. 3 prior COD slips (~4.5 year total drift). For: $689M financing closed Feb 2026; Amend 3 signed 2026-07-02 (active); LC at $13.8M. Independent estimate: 2027-Q4 at earliest if construction starts now; high drift risk toward 2028. County-abatement completion deadline (Somervell First Amendments, voted 2024-02-12) is 2026-12-31 — ~6.5 months before the contractual COD 2027-07-13; if construction has not started by early 2027 the abatement lapses too, compounding drift risk.
